title: Trapezoidal Velocity Profile Trajectory
text: Generate trajectories through multiple waypoints using trapezoidal velocity profiles, 6 inputs, 3 outputs, {End time} sets Duration of trajectory segment; {Waypoint source} sets the source for waypoints, {Waypoints} sets the waypoint positions along trajectory n -by- p, {Number of parameters} sets the number of velocity profile parameters, {Parameter 1} sets the velocity profile parameter, {Parameter 2} sets the velocity profile parameter, {Parameter source} sets the source for waypoints, {Peak velocity}, {Acceleration}, {Acceleration time} sets the duration of acceleration phase of velocity profile and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.
